meta.definition: Each held-out B mean against all 1,000 A means, including its own city.
meta.selection: All 1,000 cities and all 840,776 valid pooled-urban sampled pixels (DoU 21,22,23,30). No city or year exclusion.
meta.display: Every candidate contributes to the angle histogram. Six nearest other candidates and the correct match have highlighted rays. Ray angle is measured from the query; pairwise angles among candidates are not represented.
